title: Geometric regularity of a formal fibre ascends along a map quasi-finite at the prime
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to R'$ be a ring map of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] making $R'$ a finitely generated $R$-algebra. Let $\mathfrak q'\subseteq\mathfrak p'$ be prime ideals of $R'$ and $\mathfrak q=\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q')\subseteq\mathfrak p=\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak p')$. Assume that $R\to R'$ is quasi-finite at $\mathfrak p'$ in the sense of [pqf-def-quasifinite] (affine case, Stacks Algebra Definition 00PL), i.e. the prime of the fibre ring $R'\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ corresponding to $\mathfrak p'$ is an isolated point of its spectrum. For a prime $\mathfrak s$ of a Noetherian ring $T$ write $\kappa(\mathfrak s)=T_{\mathfrak s}/\mathfrak sT_{\mathfrak s}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and $(T_{\mathfrak s})^\wedge=\varprojlim_nT_{\mathfrak s}/\mathfrak s^nT_{\mathfrak s}$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. If the $\kappa(\mathfrak q)$-algebra $(R_{\mathfrak p})^\wedge\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak q)$ is geometrically regular over $\kappa(\mathfrak q)$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], then the $\kappa(\mathfrak q')$-algebra $(R'_{\mathfrak p'})^\wedge\otimes_{R'}\kappa(\mathfrak q')$ is geometrically regular over $\kappa(\mathfrak q')$.
